title: Amortized native record-boundary validation
scope: Replaces the quadratic boundary rewalk introduced by ed92ba1; no public signature, file format, dependency or production unsafe/lock additions.

method.reproduction: Archived scripts record exact workspace paths; rebuild the three revisions in isolated targets and adapt paths before rerunning.
method.mutation_timer: Only requested marks or recovery-open; fixture setup, validation and sync excluded. CPU/RSS/write_blocks cover the whole child, including setup.
method.memory: RSS measures process memory, not tmpfs backing or filesystem page cache. Report median per-run peak and maximum across runs; concurrent gate uses maximum. Temporary-file bytes are reported separately; on tmpfs they consume system memory.
method.storage: Ordinary cases use tmpfs; explicit disk cases use workspace disk. Files are real, not sparse.
method.concurrency_scope: Indexed SWMR write phase. Native mutation/recovery workloads are separate single-writer measurements; this does not time concurrent native liveness marks.
method.concurrency: Eight following readers plus one pinned, fixed 16384 checks per reader per mutation epoch; compare reader counts/snapshot counts/trace hashes and unchanged cache/batch budgets.
method.original_first_lazy: Same record_mark_load lazy 200000 1 fixture as the earlier 13 microsecond / 88 millisecond result; not substituted with the new multi-block fixture.

design: A private incremental sorted directory stores only boundaries established by the shared native frame decoder. Frontier publication follows a successful fallible row write.

A successful discovery scan advances strictly and stays inside the captured extent. Reverse/random/repeated/invalid offsets do not restart it. Discovery is O(N) total per handle lineage, later arbitrary membership O(log N) worst case; target validation remains per valid call.

Validated private directory rows and a constant-sized exact observed arithmetic prefix avoid discovery for known resident/own appended records. Serialized rows and lookup guesses never authorize membership by themselves.
Recovery streams two linear framing passes, replacing both the input-sized target vector and per-target prefix scans.

Boundary append buffer plus read cache borrow at most 16 KiB from the existing directory allowance; zero-loan operation spills unbuffered. Temporary disk metadata can add up to 8 bytes per discovered record. This is a storage tradeoff, not free caching.

The framing scan uses a 4 KiB stack window for adjacent small records, skips large payloads, and shares the existing decoder. Random directory probes use small windows/single rows rather than repeated 64 KiB fills.

Rewritten native directories use smaller compressed pages within the same budget and carry their observed uniform-prefix proof forward. Irregular point queries prime the estimated page before bounded sorted search; smaller pages trade compression ratio for bounded decode work.

Proofs belong to the writer handle. Existing frame geometry remains immutable under supported SWMR append/liveness operations; shrink drops the incremental proof. They do not authenticate concurrent external rewrites.

limitations: An unproven historical target still requires an initial linear framing scan. This work does not claim microsecond access to an arbitrary unindexed historical offset.
Original-baseline comparisons include the preceding security-hardening commit; whole-child CPU also includes setup/rewrite, not just the timed marks.
Point membership adds work for irregular resident layouts. All measured regressions are retained below; this is not a universal zero-overhead or 5% qualification.

Temporary proof storage is proportional to discovered record count; TMPDIR on tmpfs consumes system memory outside process RSS, so bounded heap buffers do not imply bounded total system memory. Allocation and spill failures return existing errors; this does not promise recovery from OS kills or every library/setup allocation.
Maximum physical files tested are approximately 4 GiB, not terabytes. Measurements are local five-pair medians, not statistical guarantees for all storage devices.
std::BTreeMap allocation remains deferred by the owner. No merge, version bump or crate release.

superseded_experiments.v1: Rejected random directory lookup page amplification and small-process RSS increase; see retained diagnostic results.
superseded_experiments.v9: Completed single-process suite exposed uneven large-record lookup costs; improved the bounded second lookup estimate. Partial concurrent runs were stopped and superseded, not selected as final samples.
superseded_experiments.v6: Interrupted after irregular and multi-commit random mutation costs were identified; reduced/centered prediction reads afterward. Both measurements and remaining final costs are reported.
superseded_experiments.rewrite_probe: An exploratory same-fixture probe found fixed/variable post-rewrite random marks taking 0.220/2.211 seconds versus 0.019/0.029 seconds originally. The final design carries observed proofs and uses smaller compressed pages; all final costs remain in the results.
superseded_experiments.old_security_hardening_report: Historical only. Its first-lazy numbers did not qualify reverse/random/nonresident/recovery reuse; this report supersedes those mutation claims.
